scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
What do you wan te withz me? Be gone!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你想干什么？快滚开！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
You have no more business with me, go away!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你跟我没什么好谈的，走开！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
E'llo mah frien, would I interesst tu with this rare mask? Its value I assure you is real mah frien. Tis manific!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
嘿，朋友，看看这稀有的面具，感兴趣吗？
我保证它物有所值，朋友。
真是件好东西！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ack! Forgez it! I can do bettaz en elsez where!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
啊！算了！
我去别处还能卖个更好的价钱！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Wah? O ho ho ho, so you know thaz I steal dis from those savages no? Well I won'tz give it back. But I will for a pricez... wat you say?
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
什么？哦呵呵呵，原来你知道这是我从那些野蛮人那里偷来的？
我可不会还回去。
不过嘛，出个好价钱就另当别论... 你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ahh a business man are you no?  Fine, how about...
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
啊，看来你也是个生意人？
好吧，这个价怎么样...

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Hmmm... you drive a hard bargain, ok... my final offer...
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
嗯... 你可真会砍价。
好吧... 这可是我的底价了...

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Are youz playin wit me? You don't have ze money!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你耍我呢？
你根本没那么多钱！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
O ho ho, it's a deal, then!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
哦呵呵，成交！
